title: 找到最长的半重复子字符串
summary: 求最长连续子串，使其中至多只有一对相邻字符相同。
insight: 窗口中只需记录最近一对相等相邻字符的右端点。出现第二对时，把左边界移到上一对的右端点，恰好排除上一对但保留尽可能长的窗口。
pitfalls: 统计的是相邻相同对而非重复字符种类
连续三个相同字符包含两对
左边界移动到旧相等对的右端点

solutions.title: 记录上一对相邻相等位置
solutions.idea: 维护最多含一对相邻相等字符的窗口。
steps: 若 s[right]==s[right-1] 且窗口已有一对，left=lastRepeat
把 lastRepeat 更新为 right

code.java: class Solution { public int longestSemiRepetitiveSubstring(String s){int left=0,lastRepeat=-1,answer=1;for(int right=1;right<s.length();right++){if(s.charAt(right)==s.charAt(right-1)){if(lastRepeat>=left)left=lastRepeat;lastRepeat=right;}answer=Math.max(answer,right-left+1);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun longestSemiRepetitiveSubstring(s:String):Int{var left=0;var lastRepeat=-1;var answer=1;for(right in 1 until s.length){if(s[right]==s[right-1]){if(lastRepeat>=left)left=lastRepeat;lastRepeat=right};answer=maxOf(answer,right-left+1)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int longestSemiRepetitiveSubstring(string s){int left=0,lastRepeat=-1,answer=1;for(int right=1;right<(int)s.size();++right){if(s[right]==s[right-1]){if(lastRepeat>=left)left=lastRepeat;lastRepeat=right;}answer=max(answer,right-left+1);}return answer;} };
